text: Disputing an invoice: open a billing dispute and the finance team issues a credit memo once the charge is reviewed.
A credit memo reduces the amount owed on an account. Credit memos are posted to the ledger and applied to the next statement.
Statement reconciliation: match each ledger posting against the bank statement and flag credit memo adjustments.
Payment methods: card, bank transfer and direct debit. Failed card payments are retried three times.
Direct debit mandates can be cancelled in the billing portal. The bank confirms the cancellation by email.
Rotate API keys every ninety days. Revoked keys stop working immediately and are logged in the audit trail.
The audit trail records sign-ins, key rotation and permission changes. Export it as CSV for compliance reviews.
Enable two-factor authentication with an authenticator app. Recovery codes are shown once at setup.
Deployments roll out in waves. A failed health check pauses the rollout and triggers an automatic rollback.
Rollback restores the previous release image. The rollout history lists every release with its image tag.
Canary releases send five percent of traffic to the new release before the rollout continues.
Annual leave requests are submitted in the HR system and approved by the line manager.
Office closed on public holidays. The holiday calendar is published each December.
Support tickets are triaged by severity. Severity one incidents page the on-call engineer.
The on-call engineer follows the incident runbook and posts updates every thirty minutes.
After an incident, write a postmortem within five days and review it in the weekly meeting.
